label: D2 arrival in S2 after an unrewarded trial, mostly via rare a1->S2, at low value late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the reached state is S2, and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew=0 at this D1). (phase==D2)&(state==2)&(prev_reward==0) covers 99.6% of the activation mass, but only 5% of the steps it selects are active. The largest activations come from the rare transition a1->S2 (80% of mass, top quartile 92% covered), at a low model value (5.2-7.1), and in the late episode (ep_trial >= 60, peaking at 80-89; nothing before trial 20). Common a2->S2 arrivals give weak activations. Never fires at D1/GO, in S1, or after a rewarded trial. The recorded predicate (rare a1->S2 after no reward, value<7.13) gets dev F1 0.44 and mass recall 0.76. Many matching steps stay silent, so some unexplained gating remains (episode time, longer reward history). Uses only observed variables plus the model value.
